استحثن (form X)
# اِسْتَحَثْنَ (istaḥaṯna) /is.ta.ħaθ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَحَاثَ (istaḥāṯa)
# اُسْتُحِثْنَ (ustuḥiṯna) /us.tu.ħiθ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَحَاثَ (istaḥāṯa)
# اِسْتَحِثْنَ (istaḥiṯna) /is.ta.ħiθ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَحَاثَ (istaḥāṯa)
